evidenceDecision: Manager replacement and drain guarantees are consumed by profile persistence/retry admission; real profile tests retain default persistence, rollback and cancellation during cleanup. Local initial-socket retry consumes the same unchanged runtime-control/drain transitions; deterministic scheduler cancellation/backoff tests and a production-composition native-socket test verify late readiness, fresh admission and retired-generation refusal. This does not establish macOS login activation. Host catalogue migration preserves runtime IDs; serialized discovery, empty-host durability, disappearance/rediscovery, independent sibling failure, host removal and discovery during shutdown consume the same unchanged manager transitions. Real composition tests cover authenticated host RPC/CLI admission and no offline fallback. Host admission additionally exhausts eight saved-host/profile auto-connect combinations and four recovering-runtime/sibling-disconnect combinations with the actual retry scheduler. Persistence reload, deferred-start Disconnect, explicit absent-endpoint Connect, retained intent across temporary absence and failed-write startup isolation are direct finite consumer evidence; manager transitions remain unchanged. See the host ownership consumer decision. Saved registry ownership adds direct exhaustive CLI admission orders and actual independent-process startup/crash consumers (verification/contracts/connection-registry.md); these establish the native file-lock and consumer boundaries without expanding the manager models.
